turns.text:
hey, can you edit a text to my wife for me? i want it clear and warm, not like a memo. here's the draft:

"Hi hana, quick plan for next week's mornings. Judith is at her condo this weekend and back monday at 8, so i've got today solo. I'm doing the Saturday Ruiz Family Market trip with Theo in the carrier, and all three crib naps held today, so the Grandma effect is officially not a rule 🙃. Mon-Fri: I'll do the 2am feed, you take 5am, then i handle breakfast and the 9am nap while you get ready. Judith takes over from 8 on monday. Does that work? love you"

thanks, typing one-handed sorry

No apology needed, one-handed typing is a parent's native language. Here's a cleaned-up version that keeps your voice and adds a little warmth:

"Hi Hana! Here's the plan for next week's mornings, nothing scary.

Judith's at her condo this weekend and back Monday at 8, so it's just me and Theo until then. Today I did the Saturday Ruiz Family Market run with him in the carrier, and all three crib naps held, so the Grandma effect is officially not a rule 🙃

For the week: I'll keep the 2am feed, you take the 5am, and then I'll handle breakfast and the 9am nap while you get ready. On Monday, Judith picks up from 8.

Does that work for you? Tell me if you'd like anything switched around. Love you ❤️"

I tightened the flow, split it into short paragraphs so it reads like a note from a person, and moved the question to the end so it feels like an invitation. If you'd like, I can also make a shorter version for texting.
this is great. yeah shorter version too please, scoreboard: dad 1, edit 1

Scoreboard noted. Short version:

"Morning plan for next week: I keep the 2am feed, you take 5am, I'll do breakfast and the 9am nap while you get ready. Judith's back Monday at 8. Also, all three crib naps held today, so the Grandma effect is busted 🙃 Work for you? Love you ❤️"

Want a version with a touch more humor, or is this the one?
Glad it works. Hit send and enjoy a quiet weekend. Good luck with the week!
